import unittest

from boltons.setutils import IndexedSet


class IndexedSetSliceRegressionTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.indexed = IndexedSet(range(20))
        self.indexed.remove(2)
        self.indexed.remove(11)
        self.current = list(self.indexed)

    def test_post_removal_bounds_use_apparent_indices(self):
        self.assertEqual(list(self.indexed[2:6]), self.current[2:6])
        self.assertEqual(list(self.indexed[-9:-3]), self.current[-9:-3])
        self.assertEqual(list(self.indexed[3:-2]), self.current[3:-2])
        self.assertEqual(list(self.indexed[-12:15]), self.current[-12:15])

    def test_positive_step_slices_agree_with_list(self):
        slices = [
            slice(None, None, 2),
            slice(1, 13, 3),
            slice(-14, -2, 3),
            slice(3, -2, 2),
            slice(-100, 100, 4),
        ]

        for index in slices:
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                result = self.indexed[index]
                self.assertIsInstance(result, IndexedSet)
                self.assertEqual(list(result), self.current[index])

    def test_negative_step_keeps_reverse_then_slice_semantics(self):
        reversed_current = list(reversed(self.current))
        slices = [
            slice(None, None, -1),
            slice(1, 13, -2),
            slice(-14, -2, -3),
        ]

        for index in slices:
            with self.subTest(index=index):
                positive_index = slice(index.start, index.stop, -index.step)
                self.assertEqual(
                    list(self.indexed[index]), reversed_current[positive_index]
                )


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
